title: Gimbal video audio: 'a whole fleet of them'

tellings.quote: there's a whole fleet of them. Look on ASA.

related.note: The Gimbal crew audio saying 'a whole fleet of them' is about the same fleet accompanying the Gimbal object in 2015. The story only says the formation was possibly there, while this telling hears it stated by the crew on the tape.

plain: In the Gimbal video, Navy footage from 2015 of a strange object filmed off the US East Coast, the crew can be heard saying the object was not alone: "there's a whole fleet of them. Look on ASA," an instruction to check another of their displays. The words come from the unnamed Navy aircrew recorded on the tape, which is played on the show in an episode with the Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves. If true, it means several objects were flying together, not just one.
